subject: Next steps — Redwood onboarding, procurement path & vendor packet
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@greenlighthealth.com>, Amanda Cho <amanda.cho@greenlighthealth.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — Redwood onboarding, procurement path & vendor packet

Hi Jordan / Amanda,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear about Greenlight's timeline for Q4. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement can move forward: 

- Redwood commercial path options: 1) Standard PO (Net 30) to Redwood Inference; 2) Corporate card for immediate kickoff (small pilot); 3) Marketplace purchase via AWS Marketplace (you mentioned interest).
- Procurement asks you flagged: vendor setup packet, W-9 (we can provide), bank wiring details, and GLH vendor portal form.
- Security: we already completed the SOC 2 summary on the call and can share the cert link if needed — let me know if you want the full report or just the summary.

Action items I propose:
1) I attach our vendor_setup_packet.pdf for your vendor/finance team to start.
2) Jordan — can you confirm whether Finance prefers a PO (Net 30/Net 45) or the card route for an initial pilot? If PO, please share the GLH procurement contact or preferred vendor form.
3) Amanda — if there's a vendor portal URL or an intake spreadsheet, can you send it back and I'll have Marissa (commercial ops) populate what we can.

Attachments: [Attachment: vendor_setup_packet.pdf]

Happy to jump on a short screen-share with Finance if that helps speed the vendor activation.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

From: Jordan Miles <jordan.miles@greenlighthealth.com>

Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps — Redwood onboarding, procurement path & vendor packet

Stephanie — thanks for the notes and packet. Quick answers from Finance: 

- Greenlight prefers a PO for any vendor not yet in our card program. For a small pilot we can do a PO (Net 30) to expedite.
- Required items for vendor onboarding: completed vendor_setup_packet, W-9 (or W-8 for non-US entities), banking details for wire, and our procurement intake spreadsheet (we use an internal portal too).

I've attached the procurement intake sheet our AP team uses. Please return the completed sheet and send the W-9; AP will route the PO once those are received.

Attachments: [Attachment: GLH_procurement_form.xlsx]

I'll loop Procurement (procure@greenlighthealth.com) if you prefer. We aim to have vendor activated within 7–10 business days after submission.

—Jordan
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Greenlight Health
jordan.miles@greenlighthealth.com | +1 (212) 555-0149

Can you confirm these operational items:
- Marissa: I'll need a quick commercial quote formatted to include PO number, billing address, and Net 30 terms (they may require invoice remittance info). Also confirm whether Marketplace (AWS) SKUs are available and if there's a different billing flow for Marketplace purchases.
- Sean: if we provide a filled vendor_setup_packet and the W-9, will Finance accept the PDF W-9 or do you want the scanned signed version? Also flag anything in the packet that could slow GLH's processing (e.g., indemnity language they balk at).

Quoted below is Jordan's ask for convenience.

> Jordan — Quick answers from Finance:
> 
> - Greenlight prefers a PO for any vendor not yet in our card program. For a small pilot we can do a PO (Net 30) to expedite.
> - Required items for vendor onboarding: completed vendor_setup_packet, W-9 (or W-8 for non-US entities), banking details for wire, and our procurement intake spreadsheet (we use an internal portal too).

I'll get the vendor packet returned now and attach the standard W-9. If you want, I can also offer a short walkthrough with their AP team to reduce back-and-forth.

Thanks,
Steph

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: (internal ops)
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Next steps — Redwood onboarding, procurement path & vendor packet

Thanks — I filled the GLH_procurement_form and prepared the commercial quote tied to deal RDW-2026-GLH-87. Notes and next steps: 

1) Attachments included: W-9_Redwood.pdf (signed), vendor_setup_packet_filled.pdf, and our standard invoice template that lists Net 30.
2) For PO billing: include PO number on the invoice and send invoices to ap@greenlighthealth.com; remittance address is on the filled packet. We'll request they PDF the PO back to us so AR can match and release payment.
3) Marketplace option: AWS Marketplace is available, but that route will change billing cadence (marketplace invoices go through AWS and can introduce a 30–45 day delay on our side). If Greenlight wants immediate control over the pilot and reporting, PO direct to Redwood is faster. I recommend PO for the pilot, Marketplace for later scale.
4) DocuSign link (if GLH prefers e-sign onboarding): https://www.docusign.com/en/link/redwood-onboarding-RDW-2026-GLH-87

Next actions:
- Steph: please attach W-9_Redwood.pdf and vendor_setup_packet_filled.pdf to your reply to Jordan / AP and ask them to confirm the PO number and desired invoice cadence.
- Sean: confirm that the W-9 PDF is fine (we do keep a signed copy on file); if GLH requests original wet-signatures, we'll escalate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Commercial Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
